headline: Data Center Infrastructure Cost Responsibility
short_summary: This bill shifts the financial burden of new grid infrastructure for large energy users, such as data centers, away from residential ratepayers.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP1123) on 2026-05-14
supporters: Residential consumer advocacy groups, environmental groups, Governor Spanberger's administration.
opponents: Data center industry, large industrial energy users.
news_headline: Virginia orders data centers to pay for new transmission
news_summary: The State Corporation Commission (SCC) ordered data centers to cover the cost of transmission infrastructure built exclusively for those facilities, saving Virginia families and small businesses hundreds of millions of dollars. This action followed Governor Abigail Spanberger's urging to protect Virginians from shouldering new energy costs.

headline: Data Center Water Use Transparency
short_summary: This bill mandates reporting on water consumption by data centers, providing transparency on their environmental footprint.
status: Last Action: Acts of Assembly Chapter text (CHAP0896) on 2026-04-13
supporters: Environmental groups, local communities concerned about water resources, Senator Kannan Srinivasan.
news_headline: New Virginia law requires data center water usage public
news_summary: A new Virginia law mandates that local water authorities report data center water usage, making the numbers available on the Department of Environmental Quality's website. This initiative, championed by Senator Kannan Srinivasan, aims to provide transparency regarding the industry's water consumption, which has been a top complaint.

headline: Data Center Local Siting and Noise Rules
short_summary: This bill empowers local governments to establish specific siting and noise regulations for data centers, addressing community concerns.
status: Last Action: Incorporated by Counties, Cities and Towns (HB153-Thomas) (Voice Vote) on 2026-01-23
supporters: Local communities, residents near proposed data center sites, environmental groups, Delegate Thomas.
news_headline: Virginia Lawmakers Pass Data Center Siting Bills
news_summary: HB 153 introduces new siting requirements for large data centers, mandating impact assessments on agriculture, parks, and historical sites before rezoning approval. This legislation is seen as a foundation for stronger future regulations on where data centers can be built and how they affect surrounding communities.
